title: Whop Secures $5.1B Valuation for AI Tool First Used for Sneaker Bots

tickers.name: Shopify Inc. Class A subordinate voting shares

summary:
A Series D funding round led by Sequoia Capital has provided new capital to the business-scaling platform created by founders who began using Shopify at age 13. Whop raised $205M, giving the artificial intelligence startup a $5.1B valuation and adding Sequoia's Doug Leone to the board of directors. The software uses AI to suggest business decisions for entrepreneurs launching and managing online ventures.

The company began as a niche tool to sell sneaker bots in a market the founders estimated at $20,000 per day before expanding into thousands of similar small digital markets. The new funds will be used to build economic infrastructure and support the growth of Whop's scale economies. Shopify also participated in the funding round as a strategic backer.

selectedTweets.text:
Whop has raised $200M in Series D funding at a $5.1B valuation, backed by @sequoia and @shopify.

It really feels like we are barely touching the tip of the iceberg in a market larger than anyone can imagine.

We first launched Whop as a better way for us to sell sneaker bots, one of the most niche types of desktop software out there.

Total TAM? Probably $20,000 per day.

Who cares, tiny market.

But, what people discounted is the idea that there were actually 70,000 other markets exactly like that one.

Beyond the investment itself, I am especially excited to welcome legendary silicon valley investor @dougleone to our board of directors. Doug and the sequoia team are nothing but a brilliant, resourceful, and principled group of people.

My co-founder Cameron and I started building on Shopify when we were 13 years old. Shopify is one of the most impactful all-in-one cloud ecosystems ever created; @tobi has pioneered modern entrepreneurship the way we know it and we are thrilled to have him in our corner.

We have a tenet at Whop to be the dumbest in the room and I am very grateful that this has recently become a lot easier.

We are focused on markets, scale economies, and progressive media. If that is up your alley, please message me directly.

The $200M raised will support our expansion as we build economic infrastructure for the next century, continuing on our mission of delivering everyone an income.
